mapper.select: select c.id, c.category_name, category_count.article_count, preview.article_id, preview.article_title from blog_category c inner join ( select a.category_id, count(*) as article_count from blog_article a where a.deleted_at = 0 and a.status = 1 group by a.category_id ) category_count on c.id = category_count.category_id left join ( select ranked.category_id, ranked.article_id, ranked.article_title, ranked.row_num from ( select a.category_id, a.id as article_id, a.article_title, row_number() over ( partition by a.category_id order by a.create_time desc, a.id desc ) as row_num from blog_article a where a.deleted_at = 0 and a.status = 1 ) ranked where ranked.row_num <= 6 ) preview on c.id = preview.category_id where c.deleted_at = 0 order by article_count desc, c.id, preview.row_num
